MERCHANT_GUIDE.response:
**How to Register & Sell on PMNA Perks** 🏪

**Step 1: Register Your Business**
• Go to `/business/register`
• Fill in: Business Name, Owner Name, Category, Location, Phone, Address
• Submit for admin review (approved within 24 hours)

**Step 2: Create Your First Offer**
• Go to Merchant Portal → Create Offer
• Fill in Promotion Title, Description, Category, Deal Type, Price
• 📸 **Upload Your Photo**: Drag-and-drop or click "Browse Device" to upload from your phone/laptop (PNG, JPG, WEBP, max 5MB). Photos are auto-uploaded via Multer to our servers.
• Set Start & End Dates, Terms & Conditions
• Click **Publish Promotion**

**Step 3: Boost with Showcase Ads**
• Go to Showcase & Ads section
• Pay via UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) or Credit/Debit Card
• Your promotional banner appears on the PMNA home screen to thousands of local customers!

✅ All merchants go through admin verification to ensure platform authenticity.
